items.question: How much must a customer spend on a single qualifying transaction to earn one raffle entry in this retailer's Shukran Millionaire campaign?
items.fact: Every AED 250 spent on one transaction earns one raffle entry

items.question: What is the stated monetary value of the grand prize of 1,000,000 Shukrans in this retailer's campaign?
items.fact: Grand prize of 1,000,000 Shukrans equals AED 50,000
